mapper.select: WITH ManagerAverages_51 AS ( SELECT bm.emp_id AS empId, ROUND(AVG(p.composite_score), 2) AS avgCompositeScore, ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) AS avgRevenueGrowth, ROUND(AVG(p.hygiene_score), 2) AS avgHygieneScore, ROUND(AVG(p.customer_score), 2) AS avgCustomerScore, SUM(p.claim_count) AS totalClaimCount FROM branch_managers_51 bm JOIN branch_performance_51 p ON bm.branch_id = p.branch_id WHERE bm.emp_id = #{empId} GROUP BY bm.emp_id ), QuarterlyTrends_51 AS ( SELECT bm.emp_id, p.perf_year AS perfYear, p.perf_quarter AS perfQuarter, ROUND(AVG(p.composite_score), 2) AS quarterCompositeScore, ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) AS quarterRevenueGrowth, ROUND(AVG(p.hygiene_score), 2) AS quarterHygieneScore, SUM(p.claim_count) AS quarterClaimCount, ROUND(AVG(p.customer_score), 2) AS quarterCustomerScore FROM branch_managers_51 bm JOIN branch_performance_51 p ON bm.branch_id = p.branch_id WHERE bm.emp_id = #{empId} GROUP BY bm.emp_id, p.perf_year, p.perf_quarter ) SELECT ma.empId, ma.avgCompositeScore, ma.avgRevenueGrowth, ma.avgHygieneScore, ma.avgCustomerScore, ma.totalClaimCount, qt.perfYear, qt.perfQuarter, qt.quarterCompositeScore, qt.quarterRevenueGrowth, qt.quarterHygieneScore, qt.quarterClaimCount, qt.quarterCustomerScore FROM ManagerAverages_51 ma LEFT JOIN QuarterlyTrends_51 qt ON ma.empId = qt.emp_id ORDER BY qt.perfYear DESC, qt.perfQuarter DESC

SELECT bm.emp_id AS empId, ROUND(AVG(p.composite_score), 2) AS avgCompositeScore, ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) AS avgRevenueGrowth, ROUND(AVG(p.hygiene_score), 2) AS avgHygieneScore, ROUND(AVG(p.customer_score), 2) AS avgCustomerScore, SUM(p.claim_count) AS totalClaimCount, p.perf_year AS perfYear, p.perf_quarter AS perfQuarter, p.composite_score AS quarterCompositeScore, p.revenue_growth AS quarterRevenueGrowth, p.hygiene_score AS quarterHygieneScore, p.claim_count AS quarterClaimCount, p.customer_score AS quarterCustomerScore FROM branch_managers_51 bm JOIN branch_performance_51 p ON bm.branch_id = p.branch_id WHERE bm.emp_id = #{empId} AND p.perf_year = #{year} AND p.perf_quarter = #{quarter} GROUP BY bm.emp_id, p.perf_year, p.perf_quarter, p.composite_score, p.revenue_growth, p.hygiene_score, p.claim_count, p.customer_score
